description: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of three multimodal large language models—SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B—across three distinct benchmark tasks: MathVista, MathVerse, and Physics. The horizontal axis, labeled "Benchmark," presents the three tasks in left-to-right order. The vertical axis, labeled "Score," is scaled linearly from 35 to 80, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 5. For each benchmark, three vertically stacked bars represent the scores for each model, with the legend indicating that the dark blue bar corresponds to SRPO-7B, the medium blue bar to GRPO-7B, and the light blue bar to Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. In the MathVista benchmark, the scores are 75.8 for SRPO-7B, 72.3 for GRPO-7B, and 68.2 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. In the MathVerse benchmark, the scores are 55.8 for SRPO-7B, 52.9 for GRPO-7B, and 46.3 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. In the Physics benchmark, the scores are 60.6 for SRPO-7B, 53.5 for GRPO-7B, and 45.4 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the benchmarks on the x-axis. There are no visual emphasis elements such as shading, bolding, or annotations beyond the numerical values printed atop each bar.
